item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i gnad 'dus mngon rtogs
item.coloph: khro gnyan rgyal mtshan 11 'di ni drag po las kyi mtha' thugs yin/ srid pa rgyal mo'i (mos)khro gnyan bdag la snyan du brgyud/ rim par brgyud nas gang lung ba'i (bas) yi ger bkod/ nyes 'gal yod na bon skyongs tshogs la bshags/ 'di la srid pa rgyal mo'i rgya dgu yod//
